item.title: ‘It Was a Rocky Path’—Papa Roach Frontman Jacoby Shaddix Opens Up About Radical Transformation in Christ
item.description: Papa Roach frontman Jacoby Shaddix opens up about his faith in Jesus, sobriety journey, and how his life was radically transformed.

item.title: Why Viewers Are Calling Wonder Project’s ‘It’s Not Like That’ a Refreshing Take on Faith and Family
item.description: Wonder Project’s It’s Not Like That offers a heartfelt, realistic look at faith, family, and modern parenting, earning praise from viewers for its uplifting and relatable storytelling.

item.title: Greg Laurie Urges Christians To Pray for ‘Spiritual Awakening’ in Iran and Israel Amid Unfolding Conflict
item.description: While Greg Laurie has indicated that the death of Iran’s supreme leader could mean that the rapture is near, he clarified that Christians “don’t want it to lead to Armageddon.”

item.title: Pastor Bryan Meadows Admits Lengthy Affair That Alleged Victim Describes as Clergy Abuse
item.description: Pastor Bryan Meadows addressed what he called a 12-year “affair” with a female co-pastor. That woman characterizes the relationship as abusive.

item.title: Dr. Wayne Grudem Says He ‘Changed [His] Mind on Some Things’ About Immigration After Reading Matthew Soerens’ Book
item.description: New Testament scholar Dr. Wayne Grudem said that immigration advocate Matthew Soerens has convinced him to change his mind on some matters relating to immigration.

item.title: A ‘Very Good’ and ‘Painful Thing’—Beth Moore Announces Final Living Proof Live Events
item.description: Beth Moore's ministry will hold its final Living Proof Live events, after which Living Proof will undergo a transition, although Moore will not be retiring.

item.title: ‘It Was Shocking’—Actor Skeet Ulrich Tells Horror Convention the Weirdest Fan Gift He Ever Received Was a Bible
item.description: Actor Skeet Ulrich told fans the “weirdest” gift he ever received was a Bible. The gift came from evangelist Dylan Novak, founder of Celebrity Evangelist.

item.title: What One Missionary Serving Iranian Refugees Wants Christians To Know About the Current Conflict
item.description: Missionary Eric Demeter shared his thoughts on the current Iran conflict in light of his experience working with Iranian refugees in Athens.

item.title: Movieguide Founder Dr. Ted Baehr Predicts Surge in Christian Films as Awards Stream on Great American Family
item.description: Movieguide founder Dr. Ted Baehr says Hollywood is moving toward more Christian films as faith audiences grow, ahead of the Movieguide Awards streaming on Great American Family.

item.title: Mark DeYmaz: Leading as Peacemakers in a Divided World
item.description: Pastors are called to be peacemakers. Mark DeYmaz joins Jason Daye to explore how Jesus-shaped faithfulness builds trust over time.
